question: In July 2025, which institution announced India's first AI Plus Campus in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BITS Pilani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **BITS Pilani**, a premier institute for higher education in India, announced the establishment of **India's first AI Plus Campus** in **Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh** in **July 2025**.
 
• The **AI Plus Campus** is an initiative aimed at fostering **artificial intelligence (AI) research**, education, and innovation in India.
 
• This campus will focus on offering **interdisciplinary programs** and promoting the integration of **AI with various domains** like healthcare, agriculture, and finance.
 
• The decision to establish the campus in **Amaravati** aligns with the region's growing prominence as an educational and technological hub.
 
• The initiative is expected to attract **global partnerships**, skilled professionals, and researchers, thereby contributing to the development of **AI-driven solutions** for real-world problems.<
